_comment: What the PRESENTATION site shows. Only what is listed here reaches it (the lab site website/ keeps every experiment). Change this file only when the user asks to promote something; then rebuild with build_pres_data.py, check the asserts, show the diff. Paths are relative to MMLM_AI/.

showcase.note: BADAS-JEPA-Reason (P2V, 2026-10-15, seed 0) on a 600-window training sample; only windows where the written verdict and the score agree with the ground truth
